# Oslo Bike Tours

Oslo Bike Tours offers private, fully guided bike tours in Oslo, Norway.
Small groups (max 8 people), local guides Eivind and Haakon. City tours include hotel pickup; forest and gravel tours meet at Sognsvann (the end of metro line 5, ~20 min from the centre), with hotel pickup available on request for NOK 699 per group.

## Tours

- Oslo City Highlights — 18 km, 2 hours, road, easy. Aker Brygge, Opera House, Vigeland Park, Royal Palace. NOK 890/person.
- Bygdøy Peninsula — 28 km, 2.5 hours, road, easy. Fjord views, Viking Ship Museum, Folk Museum. NOK 1 050/person.
- Oslo Gravel Short — 13 km, 2 hours, gravel, easy. Nordmarka forest north of Oslo, pine and birch, gentle climbing. Meet at Sognsvann (end of metro line 5); hotel pickup on request (+NOK 699/group). NOK 890/person.
- Oslo Gravel Loop — 25 km, 3 hours, gravel, medium. Nordmarka forest, rolling terrain, real climbs, mixed woodland. Meet at Sognsvann (end of metro line 5); hotel pickup on request (+NOK 699/group). NOK 1 090/person.
- Nordmarka Forest (Ring 4) — 45 km, 4 hours, gravel, medium. Classic Oslo cycling loop through pine and birch forest, waffle stop at Kikutstua cabin, Maridalen valley. Meet at Sognsvann (end of metro line 5); hotel pickup on request (+NOK 699/group). NOK 1 450/person.
- Epic Marka Endurance — 85 km, 6 hours, gravel, challenging. Deep Nordmarka wilderness, remote lakes, sustained climbs, rocky forest roads. Max 8 riders. Meet at Sognsvann (end of metro line 5); hotel pickup on request (+NOK 699/group). NOK 2 475/person.
- Oslo Coffee Tour — 22 km, 3 hours, road, easy. Specialty coffee stops: Tim Wendelboe, Supreme Roastworks, Fuglen, Java. Coffee and food at each stop paid separately. NOK 1 190/person.
- Oslo Architecture Tour — 30 km, 3 hours, road, easy. Nordic functionalism: Villa Stenersen (Arne Korsmo, 1939), Planetveien 12 (Korsmo, 1955), Havna Allé & Villa Dammann (1930–32), Skådalen School (Sverre Fehn, 1977). NOK 1 310/person.

## Key facts

- All tours are private — no strangers in your group
- Guide picks you up at your hotel or accommodation in Oslo
- Tours tailored to your pace and preferences
- Optional café stops available on all tours
- Bike rental as a guided-tour add-on from NOK 349; standalone day and multi-day rentals from NOK 899 for the first day, less for each day after (see Bike rental section)
- Bike not included in base price
- Helmet not included in base price
- Languages: English and Norwegian
- Group size: 1–8 people
- Based in Oslo, Norway
- Child seat available on request (mention at booking)

## Bike rental (standalone, not part of a guided tour)

- Oslo Bike Tours rents quality gravel bikes and e-bikes in Oslo, available for a single day or for multiple days
- Multi-day rentals are a core part of the business and the best way to explore the Nordmarka forest at your own pace — there is no maximum rental length (a weekend, a week, or a whole trip)
- Pricing is tiered by rental length: the first day costs most, and every day after that costs less. There is no discount code and no minimum
- Gravel and Premium E-Bike: NOK 899 first day, NOK 700 for days 2-4, NOK 600 from day 5 onwards
  - Totals: 1 day 899, 2 days 1 599, 3 days 2 299, 4 days 2 999, 5 days 3 599, 7 days 4 799
- Long Range E-Bike (largest battery, for full-day forest rides): NOK 1 199 first day, NOK 1 050 for days 2-4, NOK 900 from day 5 onwards
  - Totals: 1 day 1 199, 2 days 2 249, 3 days 3 299, 4 days 4 349, 5 days 5 249, 7 days 7 049
- Premium Gravel (carbon frame, carbon wheels, tubeless, hydraulic disc brakes): NOK 1 399 per day at any length, not tiered
- Gravel has an aluminium frame and disc brakes; Premium E-Bike covers a normal forest day
- Helmet included with every rental
- Pickup locations, all included in the price: Sognsvann (end of metro line 5, on the Nordmarka forest edge), Kjelsås (end of tram line 11), Huseby (2 min walk from Montebello on metro line 3, west Oslo, at the start of the Mærradalen gravel route up to Bogstad and Sørkedalen), or Oslo Central Station
- Hotel, AirBnB or any-address delivery available for an extra NOK 399 (subject to availability and location)
- Add-ons: seatpost bag (NOK 200), bar bag (NOK 150), frame bag (NOK 150), child trailer (NOK 350/day)
- Bikepacking Luggage Set (bar bag, frame bag and seatpost bag) — NOK 400 instead of 500; half price on rentals of 5-6 days and included free on rentals of 7 days or more (all bike types)
- One luggage set covers one bike; for more than one set, mention it at booking
- A refundable security deposit applies, arranged on confirmation
- Payment via PayPal or Stripe
- Rental page: https://www.oslobiketours.no/bike-rental-oslo/
- Note: bike rental is also available as an add-on to guided tours from NOK 349

## Booking

- Book via web form at oslobiketours.no or by email
- No fixed departure times — tours run by appointment
- Enquiries answered within 24 hours

## Pricing summary

- Lowest price: NOK 890/person (Oslo City Highlights or Oslo Gravel Short)
- Highest price: NOK 2 475/person (Epic Marka Endurance)
- All prices are per person
- Bike rental is an add-on, not included in base prices — from NOK 349

## Physical requirements by tour

- Oslo City Highlights: Suitable for all fitness levels. Flat, paved roads. No hills.
- Bygdøy Peninsula: Suitable for all fitness levels. Gentle terrain. Paved roads.
- Oslo Gravel Short: Suitable for all fitness levels including families. Gentle gravel, easy climbing.
- Oslo Gravel Loop: Recreational fitness recommended. Gravel roads, real climbing, 3 hours.
- Nordmarka Forest Ring 4: Recreational fitness recommended. Gravel roads, moderate climbs, 4 hours.
- Epic Marka Endurance: Good fitness required. 85 km, gravel, long climbs. Full-day ride.
- Oslo Coffee Tour: Suitable for all fitness levels. Flat, paved roads. Urban route.
- Oslo Architecture Tour: Suitable for all fitness levels. Gentle hills. Paved roads.
